title: St Basil's Cathedral
blurb: The Cathedral of the Intercession on Red Square, built 1555 to 1561 for Ivan the Terrible. Explore the nine chapels on one foundation: the central tent-roofed Church of the Intercession ringed by eight side churches, each with its own onion dome.

sourceUrls.label: uvisitrussia.com: interview with the Pokrovsky Cathedral chief curator

systems.name: Basement platform
systems.description: The single basement foundation platform carrying all nine chapels.

systems.name: Church of the Intercession
systems.description: The central octagonal Church of the Intercession, 46 m tall inside, with its tent roof and gilded onion dome.

systems.name: Cardinal chapels
systems.description: The four larger octagonal side churches on the compass points, each with its own onion dome.

systems.name: Diagonal chapels
systems.description: The four smaller cuboid side churches on the diagonals, each with its own onion dome.

systems.name: Chapel of St Basil
systems.description: The tenth chapel, added in 1588 over the grave of St Basil the Blessed, which gave the cathedral its popular name.

systems.name: Gallery and porches
systems.description: The vaulted connecting gallery and entrance porches linking the chapels.
